title: 第14章  三品金丹？一剑废你！
content_zh:
“补偿？呵呵，你们有什么资格让我们补偿？”
莫尘笑道。
而面对他如此强大修为，完全吊打他们两人，罗鹫却并没有担心。
因为，姬邀月给他的传音符，能召唤对战陆烬的强大存在。
所以，面对两个二品金丹境，他自是不惧。
“什么人胆敢捣乱！”
而就在此时，忽然一声闷雷般的喝声传来，一道人影从天而降！
此人气息雄浑，比起莫尘二人的修为还要强大，赫然便是达到了三品金丹之境的强者！
而且，此时身形魁梧，是一尊铁塔大汉，古铜色的肤色让他整个人看上去不容侵犯，充满威严！
“是屠魔峰陈江长老！”
“哈哈哈！陈江长老可是三品金丹强者！你们两个小砸碎，让你们多管闲事，你们死定了！”
罗鹫长老等人抱着膀子冷笑连连。
“不好！来者达到了三品！看身形，应该就是那个陈江！”
紫萱眸色有些紧张的说道。
莫尘此时眸色也是颇为意外，但是却突然喝问道：
“陈江老狗！是不是你将我凌涛师弟逼入火蛟洞窟的？！”
一句话说出，那陈江长老的眸色也是变得有些幸灾乐祸：
“哦？你们叫那凌涛为师弟？看样子，你们也是该死的人！”
他并没有明说，反而说二人该死，显然，这是一种隐晦的说法，而莫尘紫萱二人却听得明白！
这陈江，无疑，正是猎杀他们圣堂使徒的杀手之一！

圣堂，乃是楚天雄暗中建立的一个组织，其最终目的，就是要颠覆血月圣地，彻底了结血月老祖对整个青州的恐怖掌控！
“哼！果然是你！陈江，既然你逆天而为，那我们便替天行道！”
莫尘话语落下，却突然一股灵气将紫萱包裹：
“你速速离去，我来断后！”
紫萱眸色一惊，却不愿离去：
“要生同生，要死同死！我不走！”
她一剑斩断灵气束缚，然后跟莫尘站到了一起。
莫尘暗暗磨牙：
“紫萱师妹，我们打不过他！”
“我不怕！大不了一死！”
紫萱眸色决然道。
“紫萱，你知道我对你的心意，若今日无法脱身，希望我们下辈子，早点遇见！”
“下辈子，我一定给你做娘子！”
听着二人的对话，那陈江长老的眸色却充满幸灾乐祸：
“呵呵，你们两个倒是有点意思，看在你们还算有点骨气的份上，本长老倒不想让你们死得不明不白，报上名来！”
莫尘冷哼一声道：
“小爷行不改名坐不改姓，莫尘！”
“姑奶奶紫萱！吃我一剑！”
紫萱说完，顿时一剑率先刺出！
而莫尘见状，也没有半点拖沓，相随而动，一剑斩出！

陈江眸色一狠，出手便是杀招。
而此时，当那远处雷渊边缘的陆烬听到莫尘与紫萱二人名字的时候，眸色浮现出一抹意外来。
“有点熟悉的名字……是宗主给的那名单中的两个？而且还有一个叫凌涛的，也在其中！”
他虽不明白，但此时看到那陈江出手要灭杀二人，他立刻出手了！
“陈江老狗，给我滚！”
陆烬一声爆喝，出手间，一道恐怖灵气骤然爆发，竟是将那陈江所有攻击全部震碎，而他的身形也瞬间倒退到三十丈，方才颇为狼狈的稳住身形！
这陈江长老，乃是他的死敌杨巅峰的师父，所以，陆烬见到他的时候，内心的怒意也爆发了，出手间带着一股阴狠。
“什么？他的修为，竟然又晋升了！”
“七重灵珠境？这修炼速度简直匪夷所思！”
“原来那些雷劫，果然是他在闭关！”
“陈江长老，速速出手将陆烬斩杀，此子若留，必成大祸！”
罗鹫几人看到陆烬出关，并且气息达到七重灵珠境，立刻紧张起来，不断怂恿陈江长老将他就地格杀。
而陈江此时，眸色也变得相当阴沉，他甚至隐约的有些担忧！
因为刚刚陆烬那一道攻击所爆发出的强势，让他产生一种对方凌驾于他之上的错觉！
不过，看到陆烬的气息确定是处于七重灵珠境后，他才松了口气。
“圣女峰的姬峰主要我杀的人，竟是你？”
不过，震惊之余，那陈江长老的面色再次一变，到了此刻，他似乎终于认出了陆烬！
“本座的徒儿乃是血月圣地赤羽长老座下亲传弟子！陆烬，就算你强势归来又如何？今日，本长老就让你彻底消失！”
“呵呵，就凭你？可不够看！”
陆烬咧嘴一笑：

“你那徒弟杨巅峰陷害我，如今你又要杀我，老狗，那我今天就废了你，让你亲眼看着你那所谓的天才徒弟，是怎么被我踩在脚下的！”
陆烬话音落下，顿时一股灵力呼啸而出，然后一道赤色长剑虚影瞬间凝聚，下一秒直接冲向陈江长老。
“蚍蜉撼树！”
陈江眸色一变，之前陆烬归来的事情他有所耳闻，却并不知道陆烬到底有多么强大的战力。
难免因为境界上的差距，而有些轻敌，哪怕之前陆烬的攻击对他造成了冲击，此时他也没有用尽全力。
而陆烬以五重灵珠境便能硬撼金丹二品，如今七重灵珠境，三品金丹的陈江他完全能够秒了！
何况，他此时施展出来的，还是孽火镇狱剑！
长剑虚影瞬间没入陈江丹田。
速度之快，宛若一道闪电，眨眼消失。
而须臾间，陈江所有攻击全部土崩瓦解！
他站在原地，满眼都是难以置信，愣了愣，忽然身形跪倒，双手捂着小腹，嘴唇开始不断抽搐！
“你！你废了我的丹田！啊！！！”
听着这话，看到这一幕，那罗鹫等人，以及莫尘与紫萱二人的面色，全变得相当震撼！
“这……就完了？”
“三品金丹境的陈江长老，竟然就这么被一招废了丹田？”
莫尘与紫萱对视一眼，皆是满眼难以置信，不过，眼下他们的危险也算是解除了，甚至对陆烬产生了浓浓的感激之情。
“走！”
而此时，罗鹫几人忽然朝着远处逃窜！
“想走？”
陆烬眸色一沉，数道剑光瞬间冲向几人，眨眼没入几人后背，然后几人胸前鲜血飙射……
content_en:
"Compensation? Haha, what qualifications do you have to ask us to compensate you?"
Mo Chen smiled.
Faced with such a powerful cultivation level, which completely defeated the two of them, Luo Jiu was not worried.
Because the transmission note given to him by Ji Yaoyue could summon a powerful being to fight against Lu Jin.
Therefore, he was not afraid of two second-grade golden elixir realms.
"Who dares to cause trouble!"
But at this moment, a thunderous shout suddenly came, and a figure fell from the sky!
This person has a powerful aura, and is even more powerful than Mo Chen and the other two. He is clearly a strong man who has reached the third-grade golden elixir realm!
Moreover, at this time, he was a burly man with an iron tower. His bronze complexion made him look inviolable and full of majesty!
"It's Elder Chen Jiang of Demon Slaughter Peak!"
"Hahaha! Elder Chen Jiang is a third-grade golden elixir powerhouse! You two little smashers, I told you to mind your own business, you are dead!"
Elder Luo Jiu and others hugged their arms and sneered again and again.
"No! The person who came here has reached level three! Looking at his figure, he should be that Chen Jiang!"
Zixuan said with a nervous look in her eyes.
Mo Chen's eyes were quite surprised at this time, but he suddenly asked:
"Old dog Chen Jiang! Did you force my junior brother Ling Tao into the Fire Dragon Cave?!"
After saying this sentence, Elder Chen Jiang's eyes also became a little gloating:
"Oh? You call that Ling Tao your junior brother? It seems that you are worthy of death too!"
He didn't say it clearly, but instead said that the two of them deserved to die. Obviously, this was a cryptic statement, but Mo Chen and Zixuan understood it clearly!
This Chen Jiang is undoubtedly one of the killers hunting down their temple apostles!
The Holy Church is an organization secretly established by Chu Tianxiong. Its ultimate goal is to overthrow the Blood Moon Holy Land and completely end the terrifying control of the Blood Moon Ancestor over the entire Qingzhou!
"Hmph! It's you indeed! Chen Jiang, since you went against the will of heaven, then we will do the right thing for heaven!"
As Mo Chen finished speaking, a sudden burst of spiritual energy enveloped Zixuan:
"You leave quickly, I will break up the queen!"
Zixuan's eyes were startled, but she didn't want to leave:
"We want to live together, we want to die together! I won't leave!"
She cut off the spiritual energy restraint with one sword, and then stood together with Mo Chen.
Mo Chen secretly grinded his teeth:
"Junior sister Zixuan, we can't defeat him!"
"I'm not afraid! You may die!"
Zixuan said with determination in her eyes.
"Zixuan, you know how much I feel about you. If I can't escape today, I hope we can meet soon in the next life!"
"I will definitely be your wife in the next life!"
Listening to the conversation between the two, Elder Chen Jiang's eyes were filled with gloating:
"Haha, you two are quite interesting. Seeing that you still have some backbone, I don't want you to die in an unknown manner, so please sign up!"
Mo Chen snorted coldly and said:
"Young master, I won't change my name, but I won't change my surname, Mo Chen!"
"Auntie Zixuan! Eat my sword!"
After Zixuan finished speaking, she immediately thrust out her sword first!
When Mo Chen saw this, he didn't hesitate at all, and moved with him, slashing out with one sword!
Chen Jiang's eyes hardened, and he made a killing move.
At this time, when Lu Jin, who was on the edge of the distant thunder abyss, heard the names of Mo Chen and Zixuan, a look of surprise appeared in his eyes.
"The names that are a bit familiar...are they two from the list given by the sect master? And there is also one named Ling Tao, who is also among them!"
Although he didn't understand, when he saw that Chen Jiang was going to kill the two of them, he immediately took action!
"Old dog Chen Jiang, get out of here!"
Lu Jin shouted loudly, and as he took action, a terrifying spiritual energy suddenly erupted, shattering all of Chen Jiang's attacks, and his figure instantly fell back to thirty feet, before he managed to stabilize his figure quite awkwardly!
This elder Chen Jiang was the master of his mortal enemy Yang Dingfeng. Therefore, when Lu Jin saw him, his inner anger also burst out, and he acted with a sinister tone.
"What? His cultivation,He was promoted again! "
"Seventh Level Spiritual Bead Realm? This speed of cultivation is simply unbelievable! "
“It turns out that those thunder tribulations were indeed caused by him in seclusion! "
"Elder Chen Jiang, take action quickly and kill Lu Jin. If this son is left here, it will be a disaster! "
When Luo Jiu and others saw Lu Jin coming out of seclusion and his aura reaching the seventh-level spiritual bead realm, they immediately became nervous and continued to encourage Elder Chen Jiang to kill him on the spot.
At this time, Chen Jiang's eyes also became quite gloomy, and he was even vaguely worried!
Because of the power Lu Jin unleashed in his attack just now, he had the illusion that the other party was superior to him!
However, he breathed a sigh of relief after seeing that Lu Jin's aura was definitely in the seventh-level spirit bead realm.
"The person Ji Feng of Saintess Peak wants me to kill is actually you? "
However, after being shocked, Elder Chen Jiang's expression changed again. At this moment, he seemed to finally recognize Lu Jin!
"My disciple is the direct disciple of Elder Akabane of the Blood Moon Holy Land! Lu Jin, so what if you come back strong? Today, this elder will make you disappear completely! "
"Haha, just you? Not enough! "
Lu Jin grinned:
"Your apprentice Yang Dingfeng framed me, and now you want to kill me again, old dog, then I will destroy you today and let you see with your own eyes how your so-called genius apprentice was trampled under my feet! "
After Lu Jin finished speaking, a burst of spiritual power roared out, and then a red sword phantom condensed in an instant, and rushed directly towards Elder Chen Jiang the next second.
“The worm shakes the tree! "
Chen Jiang's eyes changed. He had heard about Lu Jin's return before, but he didn't know how powerful Lu Jin was.
It was inevitable that due to the gap in realm, he underestimated the enemy. Even though Lu Jin's attack had impacted him before, he did not use all his strength at this time.
Lu Jin was able to defeat the second-level golden elixir at the fifth-level spiritual bead realm, but now Chen Jiang, who was at the seventh-level spiritual bead realm and had a third-level golden elixir, could beat him in seconds!
What's more, what he used now was the Evil Fire Prison Suppressing Sword!
The long sword's shadow instantly disappeared into Chen Jiang's dantian.
The speed was so fast that it disappeared in the blink of an eye like a bolt of lightning.
And in an instant, all Chen Jiang's attacks collapsed!
He stood there with eyes full of disbelief. He was stunned for a moment. Suddenly he fell to his knees, covering his lower abdomen with his hands, and his lips began to twitch!
"You! You destroyed my Dantian! ah! ! ! "
After hearing this and seeing this scene, the expressions of Luo Jiu and others, as well as Mo Chen and Zixuan, all became quite shocked!
"This... is it over? "
"Elder Chen Jiang, who is in the third-grade golden elixir realm, could his dantian be destroyed by just one move? "
Mo Chen and Zixuan looked at each other with disbelief in their eyes. However, their danger was now relieved, and they even felt deeply grateful to Lu Jin.
"Go! "
At this time, Luo Jiu and the others suddenly fled into the distance!
"Want to leave? "
Lu Jin's eyes darkened, and several rays of sword light rushed towards several people in an instant, and disappeared into the backs of several people in the blink of an eye, and then blood spurted out from their chests...
